about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover P510e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover P510e is part of the current-generation L460 range, introduced in 2022. It uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine developed by Jaguar Land Rover as part of the Ingenium engine family. What makes the P510e distinct within the Range Rover line-up is its plug-in hybrid system: the AJ300P is paired with a 105kW electric motor, and the badge tracks the combined power output. The same underlying engine family appears across all four PHEV badges in the current Range Rover range — P440e, P460e, P510e and P550e — with different combined power outputs calibrated for each tier.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300P (3.0L I6 + 105kW electric motor) engines for every Range Rover P510e on the road.
